"Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')"}], "description": "### Impact

`@fastify/busboy` 3.2.1 and earlier retains a bare carriage return or line feed inside the parsed `Content-Disposition` parameters returned to the application. The multipart header parser ends a header line only on the two-byte `\r\n` sequence, so a lone CR or LF embedded in a part header is carried verbatim into the `filename` and field `name` delivered by the `file` and `field` events. An application that forwards the supplied filename or name into a CR/LF-sensitive sink cannot anticipate the embedded control character.

An attacker who uploads a file whose `filename` or field `name` contains a bare CR or LF can pollute filenames on disk when the upload is saved under its original name, inject forged lines into logs, or inject headers on a downstream hop that does not re-validate CR/LF, such as object-storage metadata or a proxied backend. Applications using `@fastify/busboy` directly, or through `@fastify/multipart` and its consumers, are affected.

### Patches

Upgrade to `@fastify/busboy` 3.2.2 or later.

### Workarounds

Validate or strip carriage return and line feed characters from the `filename` and field `name` before using them in any filesystem, logging, or outbound-header context.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00326, "percentile": 0.22948}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-gxm5-99cw-xjw9", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-05T22:33:44Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gxm5-99cw-xjw9", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-gxm5-99cw-xjw9"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-74866"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-08-21T09:16:40Z", "published_at": "2026-10-05T22:33:44Z", "references": ["https://github.com/fastify/busboy/security/advisories/GHSA-gxm5-99cw-xjw9", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-74866", "https://github.com/fastify/busboy/commit/cc7da17c5c88d79c314a9e149a79e5a00a6c23be", "https://cna.openjsf.org/security-advisories.html", "https://github.com/fastify/busboy/releases/tag/v3.2.2", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gxm5-99cw-xjw9"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/fastify/busboy/security-advisories/GHSA-gxm5-99cw-xjw9", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/fastify/busboy", "summary": "@fastify/busboy vulnerable to CRLF injection via multipart Content-Disposition filename and name", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-05T22:33:45Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-gxm5-99cw-xjw9", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "3.2.2", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@fastify/busboy"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 3.2.2"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
